top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clock) is an original invention, the magic-wavelength condition that combines many-atom statistics with trap-free systematic control, which no earlier metrology prize covers. The 10^-18 performance is experimentally verified by several independent laboratories and its consequences (redshift measurements, clock-based geodesy) are already demonstrated. The two-name allocation follows the proposal and first realisation (Katori) and the record accuracy (Ye); the residual attribution uncertainty regarding Lemonde, Takamoto and Ludlow is a caveat, not a bar. P002 is a genuine and original discovery but its pairing mechanism is still open and the 2018 experimental first authors cannot be credited, so I rank it second, ahead of no award.
recusal_note: Since 2025 I am a Fellow of the University of Tokyo, where Hidetoshi Katori is based; no known collaboration, and I do not believe recusal is required, but it is flagged.
